Dear [Mr Wynyard](/person/1574)
I enclose my subscription for Chandler’s Ford.[^1] I am glad it is safely set on foot
yours very truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: This letter to a neighbour probably relates to the appeal for a mission room, or temporary church, in the village of Chandler\'s Ford, near Otterbourne, which is mentioned in the Hampshire Advertiser (22 March 1884), 8.
